# The Clippy follow-up returns the outgoing password module's status

This follow-up returns the result of the password module's ForgetPassword call through .to_result(), replacing unconditional Ok(()). The username, server type, endpoint and host checks still precede the call. The fixed accepted wrapper retains this return. This is the synchronous XPCOM status contract; it does not establish propagation of every failure inside the module's asynchronous task.

Scope: Thunderbird shared Rust outgoing password removal.
